description:
## Problem
The session left worktrees in both repositories and scratch under /tmp and ~/.cache (closeout.sh, arm-*.log, rerun-*.log, preflight-*.log and others).

## Owner decision
Chosen option: "remove a worktree and its local branch only once its pull request is merged or closed and it has nothing unpushed or uncommitted, using make worktree-remove. Delete the scratch files at the very end. I list everything removed." ('I' is the agent.) Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
Run this last. For each worktree the session created, read its pull request state from GitHub and its local state from Git. Remove it with `make worktree-remove` only if the pull request is merged or closed and nothing is unpushed or uncommitted. Leave the others and say why. Then delete the scratch files. Quote ~/.cache/closeout.sh into raw-run-evidence-deleted-and-4381-authorship-record-20261120 before deleting it.

## Decision gates
Never remove a worktree with unpushed commits or uncommitted changes (today: BenchBox.wt-heavyguard, BenchBox.wt-corpus-class). Never `git branch -D` an unmerged branch. Never touch ~/.benchbox/evidence/fast-duration-gate-20261119/ or anything under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs. Do not drop `stash@{0}` (item33-pre-rebase); it belongs to another session. Other sessions' worktrees are not touched.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a list on this item of every worktree and scratch path removed, and of every one left with its reason; `git worktree list` agrees with the list.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
